improvements.rationale: These meta tags improve search engine visibility by clearly communicating the product value proposition within optimal character limits. The OG tags ensure professional, consistent previews when shared on LinkedIn, Twitter, and Facebook—critical channels for reaching business professionals. Including the free trial offer and starting price creates urgency without overpromising. The tags reinforce key differentiators: Claude-powered, voice chat, and professional trade focus.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Meet Gideon — Your AI-Powered Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Get instant answers, voice chat support, and professional guidance for your business operations. Try three free searches — no credit card required."
improvements.rationale: This headline immediately introduces the product name and its core function, building brand recognition. The subheading highlights three key value props (instant answers, voice chat, professional guidance) while clearly communicating the low-friction trial offer. The 'no credit card required' implication of free searches reduces hesitation and increases trial engagement.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches with Gideon, you'll be invited to become a member to continue accessing unlimited AI-powered trade and business support. Membership starts from just US$2 per day, billed monthly or annually—with annual plans saving you 30 percent. As a member, you'll unlock unlimited searches, voice chat, and your own dedicated workspace.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point in a freemium model—what happens when the trial ends. By clearly explaining the transition and reinforcing the low entry price and member benefits, it reduces uncertainty and supports conversion at the paywall moment.
